protocol.scope: One scoring pass on held-out qualifying telemetry after validation. Frozen before detailed test rows were opened. No inverse fit, development refit, model selection or replacement event.
protocol.coverage: Report both events with declared candidate laps, selected windows, unsupported exact DRS, retained windows, retained laps and lap/DRS groups for every filter. Zero candidates or supported windows gives no score. No substitute driver or session.
protocol.method: Take only declared conditional-motion candidates. Use unchanged pairs() from motion preparation. Apply the three original sensitivities, five stored arms, five matched-draw seeds and qualifying constant baseline to identical test rows. Predict acceleration at supplied midpoint speed by median of eligible exact-DRS development predictions. Use each sensitivity's own stored coefficients. Report fraction outside the intersection of contributing training speed ranges.
protocol.endpoint: Equal-weight mean of within-lap/exact-DRS acceleration RMSE, separately by event, in m/s2. Primary windows, shorter gaps <=0.3 s and speed >=30 m/s. Show full-volume and matched-seed ranges. All-seed/filter improvement of QP over Q is descriptive directional replication for a scored event. Assess added race value against QP and against matched QP at the same seed. No two-event generalisation with an excluded event.
protocol.reuse: After scoring, both event dispositions and all results are final for this protocol. Do not optimise on either event and present them again as untouched evidence.
